sloka: एक एव प्रजानाति विष्णुस्तेजोमयं शरम् ।एषा एव तनुः पूर्वा विष्णोस्तस्य महात्मनः ।। ७.६९.२८ ॥
transliteration: eka eva prajānāti viṣṇustejomayaṁ śaram ।eṣā eva tanuḥ pūrvā viṣṇostasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 7.69.28 ॥

translations.english: Only Vishnu truly knows this arrow, which is full of splendor, for this is indeed the ancient form of that great-souled Vishnu himself.
